name: AppSignal
summary: AppSignal bundles error tracking with performance monitoring and logging. The free plan covers 30,000 requests a month with 5-day retention, and the paid plan costs $279 a year, shown as $23.25 a month, for 250,000 requests with unlimited users and no overage charges.

facts.text: AppSignal groups an exception into an issue with other occurrences of the same error type on the same action and namespace.
Until deploy markers are added, AppSignal counts everything since the app was created as one deploy, so the new errors filter shows nothing useful.
Quotas count requests rather than errors, and the pricing page says there are no overage charges.
AppSignal states ISO 27001 certification and describes itself as EU-based.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 30,000 requests a month, 1 GB logging, 5-day retention, unlimited users

plans.name: Paid
plans.notes: Billed yearly at $279; the page showed no monthly-billing price. 250,000 requests a month, 1 GB logging a month, unlimited users

hiddenCosts: Long-term log storage and the HIPAA add-on each cost $89 a month.
Logging beyond 1 GB a month is a paid add-on.
SAML single sign-on is sold only through the Customer Success team, with no listed price.

security.ssoPlan: Enterprise SAML on request; GitHub login is free
